results.problem: Erdős distinct subset sums problem (largest element $a_n$)
results.quote: Theorem 1. If \(a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_n\) are positive integers with distinct subset sums, then \(a_n\ge 2\genfrac(){pt}{2}{n-1}{\left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor}\).

results.problem: Erdős distinct subset sums problem (second largest element $a_{n-1}$)
results.quote: Theorem 2. If \(a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_n\) are positive integers with distinct subset sums, then \(a_{n-1}\ge\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}-o(1)\right)\frac{2^{n-1}}{\sqrt{n-1}}\).
